description: This file contains functions for moving nodes within a rich text editor, including resolving nodes, swapping nodes with siblings, and moving nodes or parent nodes up or down in the document structure. It is part of the Notesnook project and interacts with ProseMirror-based editor components.

methods.name: mapChildren
methods.description: Maps over the children of a node or fragment, applying a callback to each child.

methods.name: resolveNode
methods.description: Resolves the current node or its parent based on selection context, for node movement.

methods.name: resolveParentNode
methods.description: Finds the closest valid parent node for movement operations.

methods.name: swapNodeWithSibling
methods.description: Swaps a resolved node with its sibling in the document structure.

methods.name: moveNodeUp
methods.description: Moves the selected node up among its siblings.

methods.name: moveNodeDown
methods.description: Moves the selected node down among its siblings.

methods.name: moveParentUp
methods.description: Moves the parent node up among its siblings.

methods.name: moveParentDown
methods.description: Moves the parent node down among its siblings.
